blurb: Rosewood Equestrian Center is a private hunter/jumper facility on 48 acres in East Greenville, PA. It offers boarding with fully matted stalls, indoor and outdoor arenas with jump courses, and large turnout fields. The center hosts multiple schooling level horse shows and provides training and leasing options.
